title: Agent Configurations
description: Compose System Prompts, models, tools, and Pi-native resources into inspectable configurations for new conversations.

assets.buildingHint: The latest immutable version still needs evaluation or validation.
assets.validatedHint: At least one version has frozen human-reviewed evaluation evidence.
assets.deliveredHint: At least one version has been exported through Pi Package Studio.
assets.emptyView: No Agents in this asset view
assets.emptyViewHint: Continue evaluating an Agent or switch back to the complete configuration library.

packageStatus.unknown: v{{number}} exported; open a trusted project to verify
packageStatus.missing: v{{number}} was exported; files are missing

workspace.lifecycleHint: Status is derived from immutable versions, real evaluations, and local Package evidence.
workspace.evidenceHint: Counts only local cases bound to this Agent and the latest run for each task in the current version suite.
workspace.evidenceFailed: Agent evidence is temporarily unavailable; configuration and running are unaffected.
workspace.effectiveConfigHint: Explicit Agent configuration is shown here; inherited values remain runtime-defined.
workspace.preflightHint: Recomputed from the current Pi Runtime, authorized models, and resources whenever this workspace opens.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.hint: Local sessions created with this exact Agent snapshot. Open them or promote real work into reusable evidence.
runs.empty: This Agent has not been run yet. Evidence will appear here after its first run.
runs.caseCreated: Run saved as an Agent case
runs.scenarioCreated: Run added to the current version evaluation suite
runs.noArtifacts: No file or case artifacts were recorded for this run.

observability.title: Pi run health
observability.hint: Aggregated from the active Pi branch timeline and run-boundary evidence, without model inference.
observability.loadedNotInvoked: Loaded but not invoked in this run: {{names}}
observability.sampled: Long session: only the latest {{count}} timeline records were analyzed.

turns.title: Per-turn Pi evidence
turns.hint: Every Agent run is stored independently, so later turns never overwrite earlier facts.
turns.legacy: This session has no per-turn evidence yet. New runs will be recorded from the next turn.

comparison.title: Pi run differences
comparison.hint: Shows only verifiable changes between runs and never presents correlation as causation.
comparison.notComparable: One run lacks Runtime capability evidence, so capabilities cannot be compared.

diagnosis.title: Pi evidence diagnosis
diagnosis.hint: Explains observed facts with explicit rules and routes to the repair surface; it never edits the Agent automatically.
diagnosis.healthy: No actionable issue was found in the currently stored Pi evidence.

capability-unexpected.title: Capabilities outside the configuration were loaded

context-critical.title: Context is near its limit
context-critical.body: Ending usage was {{percent}}%; inspect context composition and compaction.

context-high.title: Context usage is high
context-high.body: Ending usage was {{percent}}%; inspect it before continuing.

tool-failures.title: Tool calls failed
tool-failures.body: The active branch contains {{count}} failed calls; open the source run to inspect inputs and results.

compacted.title: Context was compacted
compacted.body: The active branch contains {{count}} compactions; output changes may coincide with summarized history.

sampled-evidence.title: This is a long-session sample
sampled-evidence.body: The summary covers only the latest {{count}} records; open the source run for the full timeline.

legacy-evidence.title: Legacy run lacks Runtime evidence
legacy-evidence.body: The original capabilities cannot be inferred from today's environment; rerun to establish evidence.

runtimeEvidence.title: Actually loaded for this run
runtimeEvidence.hint: Real resources captured from Pi AgentSession at run start, not inferred from configuration.
runtimeEvidence.notCompared: This category is environment-defined; only its actual value is recorded.
runtimeEvidence.legacy: This older run has no Runtime capability evidence, so drift cannot be inferred.

capabilities.title: Pi capabilities and dependencies
capabilities.hint: Resolve the tools, Packages, Skills, Extensions, Prompts, and project context this Agent can actually use in the current Pi Runtime.

workspace.preflightBlockedHint: Resolve the blocked local run conditions first
workspace.actionsHint: Continue running, validating, or delivering the same Agent.

identity.new: The immutable identity is new on this machine.
identity.already-imported: This exact Agent version is already in the local configuration library.

packageImport.readinessHint: Calculated from the current Pi Runtime and resources, not copied from the source machine.
packageImport.importConfigurationHint: Imported as a local candidate that must be evaluated again.
packageImport.installAgentPackageHint: Adds this local package to the trusted project's Pi settings.
packageImport.installDependenciesHint: {{count}} declared Package dependencies are currently missing.

packageImport.credentialBoundary: No credentials are imported. Complete Provider login separately on this machine.
packageImport.postflight: The actions completed and Vizruna re-ran the local preflight. Current status: {{status}}. Remaining setup items above still require attention.

packageStudio.subtitle: Validate, export, and install as a native Pi Package
packageStudio.validating: Resolving Agent and Pi resource dependencies…
packageStudio.validationPassed: Validation passed. This package can be exported and installed.

delivery.title: Target environment readiness
delivery.description: Export validity and target-machine setup are checked separately.
delivery.credentialBoundary: No API keys, OAuth tokens, or proxy passwords are included. Provider authorization must be completed separately on the target machine.

action.validation: Complete the fixed evaluation suite and validation gate before delivery.
action.runtime: Install a compatible Pi Runtime on the target machine.
action.model: Configure the required model {{value}} in the target Pi environment.
action.provider-auth: Sign in to {{value}} locally on the target machine; credentials are never copied.
action.pi-packages: Install the {{count}} declared external Pi Packages on the target machine.
action.pi-resources: Provide the declared top-level resources and repair any missing or disabled selections.
action.project-context: Provide the target project's own AGENTS.md or other inherited context files.
action.tool-policy: Pin the base tool policy if the target must reproduce the exact tool surface.

issue.project-untrusted: The current project is not trusted by Pi, so a project Package cannot be installed.
issue.inherit-resources: This Agent inherits every runtime Pi resource; available resources may differ on another machine.
issue.inherit-model: The model still inherits the current conversation, so the Package does not pin a model.
issue.inherit-thinking: Thinking level still inherits the current conversation.
issue.inherit-tools: Tool policy still inherits the current Pi settings.
issue.project-context-external: Project context such as AGENTS.md is not copied into the Package and remains supplied by the target project.
issue.external-package-dependencies: Depends on {{count}} external Pi Packages. They are not copied silently and must be installed separately in the target environment.
issue.external-resource-dependencies: Depends on {{count}} top-level Pi resources. They are not copied silently and must exist in the target environment.
issue.package-missing: {{count}} dependent Packages are missing. Repair them before exporting.
issue.resource-missing: {{count}} selected resources are missing or moved. Repair the Agent configuration first.
issue.resource-disabled: {{count}} selected resources are disabled by Pi. Enable them in Resource Center first.
issue.replace-system-prompt: This Agent replaces Pi's default System Prompt. Use this only when full prompt ownership is intentional.
issue.version-unvalidated: This Agent version has not passed its full evaluation suite and cannot be packaged for delivery.

versions.title: Agent version history
versions.subtitle: Compare immutable configurations, validate them, and choose what to run
versions.needsSuite: Create an evaluation suite for this version and pass every fixed task with the original input before validating it.
versions.notReady: Resolve every validation blocker before marking this version as validated.
versions.readinessReadyHint: All fixed tasks passed with unchanged inputs and the version does not regress against the latest validated baseline.

blockers.no-scenarios: The evaluation suite has no fixed tasks.
blockers.run-missing: At least one fixed task has no run from this exact Agent version.
blockers.review-pending: At least one run still needs human review.
blockers.task-failed: At least one fixed task failed human acceptance.
blockers.prompt-drifted: At least one run did not use the original fixed input.
blockers.baseline-required: Clone the fixed tasks from the latest validated version to establish a regression baseline.
blockers.baseline-suite-missing: The linked baseline evaluation suite no longer exists.
blockers.baseline-version-mismatch: The linked suite does not target the latest validated Agent version.
blockers.comparison-insufficient: The baseline comparison does not yet have complete, reviewed evidence.
blockers.comparison-regressed: The candidate regresses against the latest validated version.
blockers.comparison-mixed: The candidate improves some tasks but regresses others. Resolve every regression first.

versions.packageVersionHint: Only validated or released versions can be exported.
